description: Read the workspace's prepaid USD balance, the amount available for new actions (the balance minus the prices of admitted actions still running) and this month's spend, plus any one-time starter grant (starterGrantUsd), which only some eligible Free owners receive, and complimentaryVisibilityCheck (whether this user can still start the free Visibility Check). Read it before promising starter usage or that an action fits within the grant. Subscription credits remain their own allowance and are never converted to a cash balance.
